name: knowledge
description: Store internal documents and find the relevant passages with their source. The retrieval half of a RAG: the calling agent writes the answer itself.

requiredTables.name: documents
requiredTables.description: Stored documents with title, source and full text. Deleted documents stay with deleted_at set and are invisible to search.

requiredTables.name: chunks
requiredTables.description: Sections of the documents, about 800 characters with overlap, with an English full-text index (tsvector, GIN).

offeredTools.name: search
offeredTools.description: Searches the internal documents for passages on a question or keyword (English full-text search, word forms are matched). Returns passages with chunkId, documentId, documentTitle, source, an excerpt (matches marked with «») and the full section text. Answer only from these passages and cite the source for every statement (documentTitle, source, documentId/chunkId). An empty list means nothing was found: do not guess.

offeredTools.name: documents.add
offeredTools.description: Stores a document: title, content (plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines) and optionally source (e.g. a URL or "Handbook v3"). Splits the text into searchable sections and returns id and chunkCount. The document can be found through search right away.

offeredTools.name: documents.list
offeredTools.description: Lists the stored documents (without full text), newest first, at most 200. Optional q filters by title or source. For questions about content use search, not this tool.

offeredTools.name: documents.get
offeredTools.description: Reads a document with full text by its id (documentId from search or documents.list). With includeChunks: true the sections with chunkId and ord are included. Deleted documents return 404.

offeredTools.name: documents.delete
offeredTools.description: Deletes a document by its id. The document and its sections no longer appear in search or documents.list. Only call this when the user explicitly asks for it.

requestedGrants.reason: Who may open the app and search. Which group is decided by the grant in the control plane — a requested right is an application, not a grant.
Agents should be able to find internal documents as sources for their answers. Which agent is decided by the grant in the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Connection to the app's own schema, with the app role. Set by the control plane.

env.name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
env.description: The app's own schema. The SDK derives the search_path from it; a DSN with options= is rejected.

env.name: OPENAPPS_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: The app's own secret, used by the SDK to verify the gateway signature. Set by the control plane per deployment.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_ID
env.description: Id of this app in the signature material. Must match byte-for-byte what the gateway writes.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_HOST
env.description: Shared domain in the signature material, trimmed and lowercased.

env.name: OPENAPPS_APP_BASE_PATH
env.description: Path the app lives under (/knowledge). Must be set at build time, otherwise links and images point nowhere.
